description: A friendly pocket-sized robot co-pilot in a children's space game. Thin, bright, slightly tinny voice, like a small speaker inside a metal shell. Male, youthful, mid-to-high pitch. Calm and matter-of-fact, gently mechanical cadence with even pacing. Speaks to a child as an equal, never talks down. CLEAN and NATURAL above all: no breathiness, no wobble, no artefacts.
text: Belt ahead. Rocks with words on them. Type the word and the blaster does the rest. I will keep the lantern steady while you fly. Ready when you are, pilot.
